answer: A canyon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the yarrow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. What survives to the gale is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
